title: TestSprite/testsprite-cli
claim: TestSprite/testsprite-cli — Official TestSprite CLI — AI-powered automated testing from your terminal
why_good: An AI testing CLI from TestSprite that generates and runs tests from the terminal — testing is a proven paid category with clear ROI.
value: TestSprite already sells this (usage/seat); for a founder it's a competitor/benchmark, not an opening.
risk: Backed by an existing company; the opportunity is a differentiated niche, not cloning TestSprite.
pick_reason: Automated testing tools are in demand, and a CLI product can be monetized through subscriptions or licenses.
